# Files the supply-chain `secrets` job (trufflehog) does not scan. One anchored regex per line, matched against the
# repo-relative path of the changed file, no leading or trailing space. Every entry is a Go test file that holds FAKE
# credentials on purpose (fake values such as FAKEPW, Hunter2! or hosts that do not exist), to prove the scrubbers redact them.
# For a single line prefer the trailing tag `trufflehog:ignore` (in a comment on that line); list a whole file only when it
# holds many such lines. See docs/ci/RELEASE-TRAIN.md ("Secret scan allowlist"); tools/ci/test-trufflehog-allowlist.mjs keeps this file narrow.
